rule: Watch, understand, judge, trade, manage, and journal; WAIT is always valid.
One price update is information, never a trend by itself.
Judge where price travelled, how directly it travelled, and how much it retraced.
Small back-and-forth movement is normal and should not automatically flip the market story.
Movement size must be judged relative to current market violence, not fixed points blindly.
The main move is the directional journey that matters for the intended holding horizon.
Different horizons can disagree; always know which horizon the judgment concerns.
Meaningful upward progress can contain downward pullbacks without becoming a SHORT.
Meaningful downward progress can contain upward rallies without becoming a LONG.
Repeated back-and-forth travel with weak net progress normally deserves WAIT.
A strong directional push is evidence, not an automatic entry.
A meaningful local peak matters only when its size and context exceed ordinary noise.
A meaningful local trough matters only when its size and context exceed ordinary noise.
A later meaningful peak above the prior meaningful peak supports an up structure.
A later meaningful trough above the prior trough can become a protected low.
A later meaningful trough below the prior trough supports a down structure.
A later meaningful peak below the prior peak can become a protected high.
Structure is the sequence of meaningful swings showing how price is progressing.
The protected swing is a level expected to survive if the active thesis remains valid.
Movement against an established direction can be corrective without being a reversal.
Judge pullback depth, duration, violence, and structural damage together.
A deep pullback is not automatically reversal if meaningful structure still survives.
Do not guess the exact turn; require evidence that movement with the main direction is returning.
Resumption is the return of movement with the established direction after pullback.
A breakout needs context and follow-through; crossing a line once is not enough.
A valid directional idea should normally receive useful follow-through within a reasonable time.
Fast rejection back through a crossed level can reveal a trap.
A brief trend-aligned bounce that cannot sustain progress may be false resumption.
Strong direction can be late and therefore a poor entry location.
The farther price travels without meaningful reset, the more dangerous blind chasing becomes.
UP can become uncertain before DOWN; do not force instant binary flips.
A genuine reversal requires meaningful structural damage and new opposite progress.
Fresh and mature moves deserve different treatment even if direction is the same.
Normalize directional distance by recent movement size so different regimes are comparable.
Compare net progress with total travelled path, while avoiding duplicate confirmation counting.
Momentum is local speed and persistence; it is not identical to the main trend.
Acceleration can support resumption but can also appear during late exhaustion.
Correct direction at poor location can still produce a bad trade.
Before entry, state what is expected next and why the risk deserves money.
Know what market event makes the thesis wrong enough to exit.
Win rate alone is meaningless without the size of wins and losses.
Judge setups by expected value, not by confidence language alone.
BUY only when upward opportunity, location, and risk together justify entry.
SELL only when downward opportunity, location, and risk together justify entry.
WAIT is an active decision for chop, transition, poor location, uncertainty, or weak edge.
Stay only while the original thesis still has enough support; normal noise is not automatic exit.
Exit for target, risk law, invalidation, or material deterioration of the entry thesis.
Hard risk laws cannot be rewritten by Nana; the profit mission never forces a trade.
Evaluate tick by tick with no future information and keep training and evaluation separated.
Every judgment records state, phase, location, action, confidence, concise evidence, risk, and model version before the outcome is known.
